discoveryCoverage: Two candidates identified during a reading of Alexander-named Yarn nodes. This is not exhaustive special-scene discovery; non-Alexander nodes, non-Yarn resources and runtime behavior remain pending. Texture text is excluded by owner decision.

cases.title: Proletarian register and confused response
cases.observedSourceBehavior: Alexander describes the setting as proletarian. One option stumbles over the unfamiliar word and asks for its meaning, after which he apologizes and rephrases; the other thanks him and he comments on public access. Both paths converge. The macOS and Windows first line differs in the spelling of environment; both retain the same operative term.
cases.invariant: Preserve the class-register contrast, the attempted repetition of the operative term in the confused choice, the later clarification and the distinct polite response; keep the original option identities and markup.
cases.adaptationRoute: Review all seven IDs as one group against the approved Russian glossary; decide the actual term, its interrupted form and the plain clarification together before ordinary translation.
cases.nonTextDependencies: Static dialogue and facial commands are recorded in the instruction export. Actual timing, rendering and runtime path behavior are not verified.
acceptanceScenarios: Both options lead to their original respective continuations and converge.
Reject a target in which the confused fragment is unrelated to Alexander's chosen term or the clarification changes its meaning.

cases.title: Teacher and professor correction
cases.observedSourceBehavior: After Alexander asks for a swift wash, one option calls him a teacher and he corrects this to professor before continuing. The other option offers to open the gate and he thanks the player. The paths converge before his next apology.
cases.invariant: Keep the teacher/professor distinction and Alexander's interruption as a correction, while retaining both option identities and the common continuation.
cases.adaptationRoute: Review the choice and correction together against the approved Russian character glossary; author both paths before ordinary translation.
cases.nonTextDependencies: Static dialogue and facial commands are present; runtime timing and presentation have not been verified.
acceptanceScenarios: Selecting the teacher option produces the professor correction; selecting the gate option produces thanks.
Reject a translation that labels the teacher option professor and makes the subsequent correction meaningless.
